cod_assessment.rationale: Construction is underway (grading + access roads by 2026-07-20), which supports a real project on a ~2028 timeline; but only earthworks are visible (no modules/racking), and construction has STARTED BEFORE FIS approval ('meets all 6.9' and FIS both not achieved as of the Jun 2026 queue snapshot) — a real schedule risk if final POI design forces rework. The reported 2027-12-31 COD is optimistic for a ~400 MW joint build at the earthworks stage; independent estimate ~2028. Drift risk moderate-to-high (floor is moderate now that construction has begun).
